label: Distinct concurrent giving from present-tense receipt and correlativity (inference)
rule: Use present-tense receipt and correlativity to obtain a giver there, then exclude identity by scoped non-self-giving
meaning: Assembly over the same primitive Receipt parameter in both premises. The existing receipt derivation produces a giver at the recipient's moment t; scoped non-self-giving makes that witness distinct. On the standing interpretation the productive burden falls on correlativity; on the passion interpretation it falls on receipt at every moment.
